mechanism: Trimethoprim inhibits renal tubular secretion of creatinine and can reduce creatinine clearance, potentially altering levodopa pharmacokinetics and increasing CNS exposure, while both drugs may have additive effects on folate metabolism affecting dopaminergic function.
action: Monitor renal function and levodopa efficacy/adverse effects during concurrent use; consider alternative antibiotic if prolonged trimethoprim therapy is needed in patients on carbidopa-levodopa.
